name: @mikeargento/bitgraph
description: Portable cryptographic proof of construction for digital artifacts.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/verify && npm run build --workspace=packages/audit && tsc
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/verify && npm run build --workspace=packages/audit && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:core: npm run build && node --test dist/__tests__/canonical.test.js dist/__tests__/constructor.test.js dist/__tests__/verifier.test.js dist/__tests__/proof-integrity.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-ingest.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-tiers.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-reconstruct.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-anomalies.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-anchors.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-witness.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-temporal.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-attestation.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-report.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-property.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-real-fixtures.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-dependencies.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-bench-smoke.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-roundtrip.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-real-live.test.js dist/__tests__/chain-hash-anchor.test.js dist/__tests__/audit-boundary.test.js
